candidate.name: intraday_market_range_profile_synchronization_240m
candidate.mechanism: Same-date leave-one-out market synchronization of the fixed-clock distribution of intrabar log high-low ranges.
candidate.formula: Normalize each complete 240-vector q_i=log(high_i/low_i) by its positive sum. For each date and clock position, subtract the candidate stock's profile from the frozen complete-profile sum and divide by the leave-one-out count. Return the equal-clock-weight population Pearson correlation of the stock and peer-mean vectors.
candidate.exact_support_predicate: The raw stock-day has the exact immutable 241-row identity; all 240 selected high/low pairs are finite, strictly positive, and ordered low<=high; sum(log(high/low)) is finite and strictly positive; the stock normalized profile is finite and nonconstant; at every clock position the leave-one-out benchmark count is at least 50; and the leave-one-out mean profile is finite and nonconstant.
candidate.zero_semantics: A zero-range bar contributes exact zero at its fixed clock. There is no minimum positive-range count, no minimum adjacent-pair count, and no bridge, imputation, epsilon, dropped bar, threshold, or support repair.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_market_amount_profile_synchronization_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both correlate one normalized 240-clock profile with a same-date leave-one-out peer mean.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: The terminal factor measures market-wide participation timing from CNY amount. Campaign097 measures market-wide volatility timing from log high-low range. Redistributing ranges with amount fixed changes Campaign097 only; redistributing amount with ranges fixed changes the terminal factor only. Range and amount are separate accepted source mechanisms, not a unit substitution.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_range_amount_profile_alignment_js_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both use a normalized range profile.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Campaign087 compares one stock's range and amount distributions with Jensen-Shannon similarity. Campaign097 contains no amount and cannot be computed from one stock; changing peer ranges changes Campaign097 while Campaign087 is fixed.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_morning_afternoon_range_profile_similarity_120b
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both retain the clock shape of high-low ranges.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: The terminal factor compares two halves of one stock and is peer invariant. Campaign097 compares the full fixed 240-clock profile with contemporaneous other stocks and is not a half-session symmetry statistic.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_intrabar_range_participation_entropy_240m, intraday_range_clock_center_240m, and intraday_range_local_peak_clock_dispersion_236p
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: All summarize the intraday allocation or topology of range mass.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Those are own-stock marginal entropy, first clock moment, or strict-peak clock variance. Campaign097 is a peer-dependent aligned-profile correlation; equal own entropy, center, and peak dispersion can coexist with different market synchronization.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_market_idiosyncratic_share_238m, intraday_market_dispersion_decoupling_238m, and intraday_market_directional_sign_agreement_238m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: All depend on a contemporaneous market peer population.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Those factors use signed or absolute close returns, covariance, dispersion, or sign agreement. Campaign097 reads no close or return and measures aligned high-low range allocation after per-stock normalization.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_cross_sectional_standardized_return_state_stability_236p
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both use a leave-one-out cross-sectional benchmark.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Campaign063 standardizes every close return by same-position peer variance and then measures adjacent z-state mobility. Campaign097 never estimates peer variance, never standardizes a stock by peer scale, never forms adjacent pairs, and remains defined when an individual clock has zero peer range.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: candidate49_intraday_cumulative_vwap_crossing_rate_240m_v1
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both are known only after the completed signal session.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Candidate49 counts causal close-versus-cumulative-VWAP crossings and requires amount/volume. Campaign097 is historical-only, reads only high/low plus peers, and does not touch the prospective ledgers.
